description: This file defines classes and structures for decoding User-Plane messages in an Open Fronthaul system, including a specific implementation class for message decoding with decompression support.

classes.name: decoder_uplane_section_params
classes.description: Structure holding parameters for a User-Plane section in the decoder.

classes.name: uplane_message_decoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation class for decoding User-Plane messages, supporting decompression and section parsing.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a User-Plane message into results.

methods.name: decode_all_sections
methods.description: Decodes all sections within the message.

methods.name: decode_section
methods.description: Decodes a single section and returns its status.

methods.name: decode_section_header
methods.description: Decodes the header of a section.

methods.name: decode_iq_data
methods.description: Decodes IQ data from the deserializer.
